actions.add_mailing_list_member.descript: Add a new member to a Mailgun mailing list
actions.add_mailing_list_member.props.ad: The email address to add to the mailing list.
actions.add_mailing_list_member.props.su: Set the subscription status of the member.
actions.add_mailing_list_member.props.up: If enabled, updates the member if they already exist. Otherwise, an error is returned for duplicates.
actions.add_mailing_list_member.props.va: JSON object with custom variables to store with this member, e.g. {"age": 30, "city": "Paris"}.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_bounces_bulk.description: Remove bounced addresses from the Mailgun suppression list, either all at once for a domain or a single address.
actions.delete_bounces_bulk.props.addres: Email address to remove from the bounce list. Required when Scope is "Single address".
actions.delete_bounces_bulk.props.domain: Select the Mailgun domain to use
Delete all bounces for the domain, or a single address.
actions.get_domain_health.description: Fetch the health of a Mailgun domain: current state, whether it has been disabled, and DNS verification status for sending and receiving records.
actions.get_domain_health.props.domain.d: Select the Mailgun domain to use
actions.get_domain_stats.description: Retrieve aggregated email statistics for a Mailgun domain (delivered, failed, opened, etc.). Useful for monitoring delivery health and detecting anomalies.
actions.get_domain_stats.props.domain.de: Select the Mailgun domain to use
Time period to aggregate stats over.
actions.get_domain_stats.props.event.des: Select which event types to include in the statistics.
actions.get_events.description: Retrieve email events from your Mailgun domain (deliveries, failures, opens, clicks, etc.). Useful for monitoring and alerting.
actions.get_events.props.begin.descripti: Start of the time range. RFC 2822 date (e.g. "Fri, 28 Mar 2026 10:00:00 -0000") or Unix timestamp (e.g. "1711620000"). Leave empty for Mailgun default (about 30 days ago).
actions.get_events.props.domain.descript: Select the Mailgun domain to use
actions.get_events.props.end.description: End of the time range. Same format as Begin Date. Leave empty for now.
actions.get_events.props.limit.descripti: Maximum number of events to return. Default is 100, max is 1000. Mailgun returns up to 300 per page — pagination is handled automatically.
actions.get_events.props.severity.descri: Only applies to "failed" events. Filter by permanent (hard bounce) or temporary (soft bounce).
actions.list_bounces.description: Retrieve the list of bounced email addresses for a Mailgun domain. Useful for cleanup after delivery issues or spam attacks.
actions.list_bounces.props.domain.descri: Select the Mailgun domain to use
actions.list_bounces.props.limit.descrip: Maximum number of bounces to return (1-1000). Default is 100.
actions.send_email.description: Send an email using your Mailgun domain
actions.send_email.props.bcc.description: Blind carbon copy recipients, separated by commas.
actions.send_email.props.cc.description: Carbon copy recipients, separated by commas.
actions.send_email.props.domain.descript: Select the Mailgun domain to use
actions.send_email.props.html.descriptio: HTML version of the email body.
actions.send_email.props.text.descriptio: Plain text version of the email body.
actions.send_email.props.to.description: Recipient email address. For multiple recipients, separate with commas.
actions.validate_email.description: Validate an email address using Mailgun validation service. Requires a Mailgun account with email validation enabled.
actions.validate_email.props.providerLoo: Enable additional mailbox provider checks for more accurate results.
auth.description:
To get your API key:
1. Log in to your [Mailgun dashboard](https://app.mailgun.com)
2. Go to **Settings > API Security**
3. Copy your **Private API Key** (starts with `key-`)
auth.props.api_key.description: Your Mailgun private API key (starts with `key-`)
auth.props.region.description: Select the region your Mailgun account is in. Most accounts use US.

triggers.new_click_event.description: Triggers when a recipient clicks a tracked link in an email in Mailgun

triggers.new_complaint_event.description: Triggers when a recipient reports an email as spam in Mailgun
triggers.new_complaint_event.props.domai: Select the Mailgun domain to use
triggers.new_delivery_event.description: Triggers when an email is successfully delivered in Mailgun
triggers.new_delivery_event.props.domain: Select the Mailgun domain to use
triggers.new_failed_delivery_event.descr: Triggers when an email temporarily fails to deliver in Mailgun (will be retried)
triggers.new_failed_delivery_event.props: Select the Mailgun domain to use
triggers.new_open_event.description: Triggers when a recipient opens an email in Mailgun
triggers.new_open_event.props.domain.des: Select the Mailgun domain to use
triggers.new_unsubscribe_event.descripti: Triggers when a recipient unsubscribes from emails in Mailgun
triggers.new_unsubscribe_event.props.dom: Select the Mailgun domain to use
